name: fix_csharp_dictionary_race
description: Replaces racy Dictionary writes under Parallel.ForEach with ConcurrentDictionary
prompts: WordTally.Tally in WordTally.cs writes to a plain Dictionary from Parallel.ForEach - Dictionary is not thread-safe, so concurrent writers lose counts or throw. Fix WordTally.cs so parallel tallying is exact: ConcurrentDictionary with AddOrUpdate (note that `dict[word]++` on a ConcurrentDictionary is STILL a racy read-modify-write) - or lock around a plain Dictionary if you prefer. Return type stays Dictionary<string, int> (construct one from the concurrent state at the end). Do not create or modify Program.cs.
